title: tjvz model state (model.json)
description: Per-profile STATE (survives rm -rf .tjvz/). The weights the one model currently ranks with and how they were arrived at. Until a learn run is adopted these mirror config.yaml model.scoring; `tjvz model learn --adopt` replaces them if the learning.adopt gates pass. There is no model plugin - see model-config.schema.json.

source.description: prior = hand-set weights copied from config.yaml. learned = adopted from `tjvz model learn --adopt`.

weights.description: feature id -> coefficient, for every feature the model uses.

features_fingerprint.description: sha256[:12] over the sorted (feature id, version, hash) triples of the feature set these weights were derived for. When it differs from the live registry the model is stale — `tjvz model status` flags it, refit clears it.

learned_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the adopted learn; null when source = prior.

learned.description: Diagnostics from the adopted learn run; null when source = prior.

cv_score_prior.description: The same metric for the prior weights on the same CV folds. The learn run must beat this to be adopted.

events_through.description: Timestamp of the last event included in the learn run.
